summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 5 new pytest cases pass; all UI scenarios pass. Per-product discount is fixed/read-only in catalog (no discount input, only discount-value-<id> labels), product search filters by name AND manufacturer with clear button, chips still work, invoice shows PIB + Adresa + Telefon + Email, admin form-discount saves and persists. Full order math verified: 450*4*(1-0.05)=1710 net, VAT 20% -> grand 2.052,00.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking; likely from a dependency (BlurView/Modal).
